import React, { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import heroImage from "./assets/vighnex.png";

export default function Home() {
  const [menuOpen, setMenuOpen] = useState(false);
  const [activeFaq, setActiveFaq] = useState(0);
  const [scrolled, setScrolled] = useState(false);
  const [mobile, setMobile] = useState(window.innerWidth <= 850);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleScroll = () => setScrolled(window.scrollY > 40);
    const handleResize = () => setMobile(window.innerWidth <= 850);
    window.addEventListener("scroll", handleScroll);
    window.addEventListener("resize", handleResize);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("scroll", handleScroll);
      window.removeEventListener("resize", handleResize);
    };
  }, []);

  const C = {
    navy: "#092338",
    navy2: "#12344c",
    gold: "#c89032",
    gold2: "#e6b85c",
    cream: "#faf7f0",
    white: "#fff",
    text: "#11243a",
    muted: "#637181",
    light: "#f3ecdf",
  };

  const styles = {
    site: { overflow: "hidden", background: C.cream, color: C.text, fontFamily: "Inter,Arial,sans-serif" },
    container: { width: "min(1180px,92%)", margin: "auto" },
    section: { padding: mobile ? "75px 0" : "105px 0", position: "relative" },
    dark: { background: "linear-gradient(135deg,#071f32,#0d354c)", color: C.white },
    title: { textAlign: "center", maxWidth: 720, margin: "0 auto 60px" },
    eyebrow: { display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center", gap: 10, color: C.gold, fontSize: 12, letterSpacing: 4, fontWeight: 800, textTransform: "uppercase", marginBottom: 14 },
    h2: { fontFamily: "Georgia,serif", fontSize: mobile ? 38 : "clamp(36px,5vw,58px)", lineHeight: 1.05, marginBottom: 18, color: C.navy },
    p: { fontSize: 17, lineHeight: 1.8, color: C.muted },
    btn: { border: 0, borderRadius: 50, padding: "15px 25px", fontSize: 14, fontWeight: 800, cursor: "pointer", display: "inline-flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center", gap: 10, textDecoration: "none" },
    primary: { background: C.navy, color: C.white, boxShadow: "0 12px 28px rgba(9,35,56,.18)" },
    goldBtn: { background: `linear-gradient(135deg,${C.gold2},${C.gold})`, color: "#152536" },
    navbar: { position: "fixed", left: 0, right: 0, top: 0, height: 78, zIndex: 1000, display: "flex", alignItems: "center", background: "rgba(250,247,240,.94)", backdropFilter: "blur(14px)", boxShadow: scrolled ? "0 8px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.08)" : "none" },
    navInner: { display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "space-between" },
    logo: { display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 10, cursor: "pointer" },
    logoMark: { width: 43, height: 43, borderRadius: 13, background: "linear-gradient(145deg,#e9b348,#b97a20)", display: "grid", placeItems: "center", color: C.white, fontFamily: "Georgia,serif", fontSize: 23, fontWeight: "bold", boxShadow: "0 7px 18px rgba(200,144,50,.22)" },
    logoStrong: { display: "block", fontFamily: "Georgia,serif", fontSize: 22, lineHeight: "20px", color: C.navy },
    logoSmall: { fontSize: 9, letterSpacing: 3, color: "#687481" },
    nav: { display: mobile ? "none" : "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 25 },
    navMobile: { position: "absolute", top: 78, left: 0, right: 0, background: "rgba(250,247,240,.99)", padding: 25, display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 5, boxShadow: "0 20px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.08)" },
    navButton: { border: 0, background: "none", fontWeight: 700, color: "#24384b", cursor: "pointer", fontSize: 13, padding: 8 },
    menu: { display: mobile ? "block" : "none", background: "none", border: 0, color: C.navy, cursor: "pointer" },
    hero: { minHeight: mobile ? "auto" : 760, paddingTop: mobile ? 120 : 150, paddingBottom: 80, position: "relative", background: "radial-gradient(circle at 78% 35%,rgba(214,169,78,.2),transparent 32%),linear-gradient(110deg,#faf7f0 40%,#f0e5ce)" },
    heroGrid: { display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: mobile ? "1fr" : "1fr 1fr", gap: 50, alignItems: "center", position: "relative", zIndex: 2 },
    heroH1: { fontFamily: "Georgia,serif", fontSize: mobile ? 48 : "clamp(48px,6.2vw,78px)", lineHeight: .98, color: C.navy, letterSpacing: -2 },
    heroP: { maxWidth: 600, fontSize: mobile ? 15 : 18, lineHeight: 1.75, color: "#566575", margin: "27px 0 32px" },
    actions: { display: "flex", gap: 14, flexWrap: "wrap" },
    heroNote: { display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 12, marginTop: 30, color: "#526274", fontSize: 13 },
    visual: { position: "relative", minHeight: mobile ? 390 : 520, display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center" },
    heroImg: { width: mobile ? 285 : 430, height: mobile ? 390 : 500, objectFit: "cover", borderRadius: mobile ? "160px 160px 25px 25px" : "220px 220px 30px 30px", boxShadow: "25px 30px 70px rgba(29,45,58,.2)", border: "8px solid rgba(255,255,255,.75)" },
    badge: { position: "absolute", background: C.white, padding: mobile ? 12 : 18, borderRadius: 18, boxShadow: "0 15px 40px rgba(20,40,55,.13)", display: "flex", gap: 12, alignItems: "center" },
    badgeIcon: { width: 43, height: 43, borderRadius: 13, background: "#fff2d4", color: C.gold, display: "grid", placeItems: "center" },
    badgeStrong: { display: "block", color: C.navy, fontSize: mobile ? 12 : 15 },
    badgeSpan: { fontSize: mobile ? 9 : 11, color: "#7a8792" },
    grid2: { display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: mobile ? "1fr" : "1fr 1fr", gap: mobile ? 45 : 80, alignItems: "center" },
    aboutImg: { width: "100%", height: mobile ? 430 : 540, objectFit: "cover", borderRadius: 25, boxShadow: "20px 25px 60px rgba(17,36,58,.13)" },
    aboutCard: { position: "absolute", right: mobile ? 5 : -25, bottom: 30, background: C.navy, color: C.white, padding: 25, borderRadius: 20, width: 200, textAlign: "center", boxShadow: "0 20px 45px rgba(9,35,56,.25)" },
    aboutNumber: { display: "block", fontFamily: "Georgia,serif", fontSize: 39, color: C.gold2 },
    aboutText: { fontSize: 12, color: "#d5e0e7" },
    aboutH2: { ...styles.h2, textAlign: "left" },
    aboutP: { fontSize: 16, lineHeight: 1.85, color: C.muted, marginBottom: 17 },
    values: { display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: mobile ? "1fr" : "1fr 1fr", gap: 15, margin: "28px 0" },
    value: { padding: 17, border: "1px solid #e8decb", borderRadius: 15, background: C.white },
    valueStrong: { display: "block", marginBottom: 5, color: C.navy },
    valueSpan: { fontSize: 12, color: C.muted },
    services: { display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: mobile ? "1fr" : window.innerWidth <= 1050 ? "repeat(3,1fr)" : "repeat(5,1fr)", gap: 16 },
    service: { background: C.white, borderRadius: 20, padding: 18, minHeight: 405, transition: ".3s", position: "relative", overflow: "hidden", boxShadow: "0 8px 25px rgba(0,0,0,.08)" },
    serviceImg: { width: "100%", height: 135, objectFit: "cover", borderRadius: 14, display: "block", marginBottom: 18 },
    serviceIcon: { width: 50, height: 50, borderRadius: 15, display: "grid", placeItems: "center", background: "#fff1cf", color: C.gold, marginBottom: 16 },
    serviceH3: { fontFamily: "Georgia,serif", fontSize: 20, marginBottom: 10, color: C.navy },
    serviceP: { color: "#60717f", fontSize: 13, lineHeight: 1.7, marginBottom: 16 },
    tags: { display: "flex", flexWrap: "wrap", gap: 6 },
    tag: { fontSize: 10, border: "1px solid #d9e2e8", borderRadius: 20, padding: "6px 8px", color: "#60717f" },
    why: { display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: mobile ? "1fr" : "1fr 1fr", gap: mobile ? 45 : 75, alignItems: "center" },
    whyH2: { ...styles.h2, color: C.white },
    whyP: { lineHeight: 1.8, color: "#b9cad4", marginBottom: 25 },
    whyList: { display: "grid", gap: 17 },
    whyItem: { display: "flex", gap: 15, alignItems: "flex-start" },
    check: { width: 35, height: 35, minWidth: 35, borderRadius: "50%", background: "rgba(230,184,92,.15)", color: C.gold2, display: "grid", placeItems: "center" },
    whySpan: { fontSize: 13, lineHeight: 1.5, color: "#a9bdc9" },
    whyPhoto: { height: mobile ? 450 : 580, objectFit: "cover", width: "100%", borderRadius: 30, boxShadow: "0 25px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.2)" },
    tech: { display: "flex", flexWrap: "wrap", justifyContent: "center", gap: 12, maxWidth: 900, margin: "auto" },
    techItem: { background: C.white, border: "1px solid #e9e0d0", padding: "17px 23px", borderRadius: 15, display: "flex", gap: 10, alignItems: "center" },
    dot: { width: 9, height: 9, borderRadius: "50%", background: C.gold },
    techSmall: { color: "#85909b" },
    process: { display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: mobile ? "1fr 1fr" : window.innerWidth <= 1050 ? "repeat(3,1fr)" : "repeat(6,1fr)", gap: 25 },
    processItem: { position: "relative", textAlign: "center" },
    processNum: { fontFamily: "Georgia,serif", fontSize: 13, color: C.gold, marginBottom: 10 },
    processIcon: { width: 76, height: 76, borderRadius: "50%", border: "1px solid #e1c78d", background: C.white, margin: "0 auto 18px", display: "grid", placeItems: "center", color: C.gold, boxShadow: "0 12px 30px rgba(50,40,20,.07)" },
    processH3: { fontFamily: "Georgia,serif", marginBottom: 8, color: C.navy },
    processP: { fontSize: 12, lineHeight: 1.6, color: C.muted },
    stats: { background: C.navy, color: C.white, padding: "70px 0" },
    statsGrid: { display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "repeat(4,1fr)", gap: 20, textAlign: "center" },
    stat: { padding: 20, borderRight: mobile ? 0 : "1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15)" },
    statStrong: { fontFamily: "Georgia,serif", fontSize: mobile ? 38 : 50, color: C.gold2, display: "block" },
    statSpan: { fontSize: 13, color: "#bdcdd6" },
    projects: { display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: mobile ? "1fr" : "repeat(3,1fr)", gap: 22 },
    project: { background: C.white, borderRadius: 22, overflow: "hidden", boxShadow: "0 10px 35px rgba(25,43,60,.08)" },
    projectImg: { width: "100%", height: 250, objectFit: "cover", display: "block" },
    projectBody: { padding: 25 },
    category: { fontSize: 10, color: C.gold, fontWeight: 800, letterSpacing: 2, textTransform: "uppercase" },
    projectH3: { fontFamily: "Georgia,serif", fontSize: 27, margin: "8px 0", color: C.navy },
    projectP: { fontSize: 13, lineHeight: 1.7, color: C.muted, marginBottom: 17 },
    projectLink: { border: 0, background: "none", color: C.navy, fontWeight: 800, cursor: "pointer", display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 7 },
    testimonials: { display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: mobile ? "1fr" : "repeat(3,1fr)", gap: 22 },
    testimonial: { background: C.white, border: "1px solid #eee5d7", borderRadius: 22, padding: 30 },
    stars: { color: C.gold, display: "flex", gap: 2, marginBottom: 20 },
    testimonialP: { fontFamily: "Georgia,serif", fontSize: 18, lineHeight: 1.65, color: "#33495b", marginBottom: 25 },
    person: { display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 13 },
    personImg: { width: 52, height: 52, borderRadius: "50%", objectFit: "cover" },
    personRole: { fontSize: 11, color: C.muted },
    faqWrap: { maxWidth: 850, margin: "auto" },
    faq: { borderBottom: "1px solid #e1d8ca" },
    faqQ: { width: "100%", padding: 24, paddingLeft: 0, paddingRight: 0, background: "none", border: 0, display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center", textAlign: "left", cursor: "pointer", color: C.navy, fontSize: 17, fontWeight: 800 },
    faqAnswer: { overflow: "hidden", color: C.muted, lineHeight: 1.8, fontSize: 14, padding: activeFaq >= 0 ? "0 40px 22px 0" : 0 },
    contact: { background: "linear-gradient(135deg,#071f32,#123b52)", color: C.white },
    contactGrid: { display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: mobile ? "1fr" : ".85fr 1.15fr", gap: mobile ? 45 : 70, alignItems: "start" },
    contactH2: { ...styles.h2, color: C.white },
    contactP: { color: "#b8cad5", lineHeight: 1.8, marginBottom: 30 },
    details: { display: "grid", gap: 18 },
    detail: { display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 14 },
    detailIcon: { width: 43, height: 43, borderRadius: 13, background: "rgba(230,184,92,.13)", color: C.gold2, display: "grid", placeItems: "center" },
    detailStrong: { display: "block", fontSize: 13, marginBottom: 3 },
    detailSpan: { fontSize: 12, color: "#adc0cb" },
    form: { background: C.white, color: C.navy, borderRadius: 25, padding: mobile ? 24 : 35, boxShadow: "0 25px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.2)" },
    formTitle: { fontFamily: "Georgia,serif", fontSize: 30, marginBottom: 22 },
    formGrid: { display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: mobile ? "1fr" : "1fr 1fr", gap: 15 },
    field: { marginBottom: 15 },
    label: { display: "block", fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 800, marginBottom: 7, color: "#556575" },
    input: { width: "100%", border: "1px solid #e1e5e8", borderRadius: 12, padding: 14, fontFamily: "inherit", outline: "none", background: "#fbfcfd" },
    textarea: { width: "100%", minHeight: 120, resize: "vertical", border: "1px solid #e1e5e8", borderRadius: 12, padding: 14, fontFamily: "inherit", outline: "none", background: "#fbfcfd" },
    select: { width: "100%", border: "1px solid #e1e5e8", borderRadius: 12, padding: 14, fontFamily: "inherit", outline: "none", background: "#fbfcfd" },
    footer: { background: "#061b2b", color: "#b7c7d0", padding: "60px 0 25px" },
    footerGrid: { display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: mobile ? "1fr" : "1.5fr 1fr 1fr 1fr", gap: 40, paddingBottom: 45 },
    footerDescription: { fontSize: 13, lineHeight: 1.8, maxWidth: 320, marginTop: 18 },
    footerH4: { color: C.white, marginBottom: 18, fontSize: 14 },
    footerLinks: { display: "grid", gap: 11 },
    footerButton: { background: "none", border: 0, color: "#aebec8", textAlign: "left", cursor: "pointer", fontSize: 12 },
    bottom: { borderTop: "1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1)", paddingTop: 23, display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", gap: 20, fontSize: 11, flexDirection: mobile ? "column" : "row" },
    socials: { display: "flex", gap: 8 },
    social: { width: 34, height: 34, border: "1px solid #385263", borderRadius: "50%", display: "grid", placeItems: "center", color: "#c4d2d9", textDecoration: "none" }
  };

  const scrollTo = (id) => {
    setMenuOpen(false);
    const el = document.getElementById(id);
    if (el) el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });
  };

  const Icon = ({ type, size = 26 }) => {
    const icons = {
      code: <><path d="M9 18 3 12l6-6" /><path d="m15 6 6 6-6 6" /><path d="m14 4-4 16" /></>,
      design: <><rect x="3" y="3" width="18" height="18" rx="3" /><path d="M8 8h8M8 12h5M8 16h8" /></>,
      marketing: <><path d="M3 11v2M6 9v6M9 7v10M12 5v14M15 8v8M18 10v4M21 12h.01" /></>,
      mobile: <><rect x="6" y="2" width="12" height="20" rx="3" /><path d="M10 18h4" /></>,
      cloud: <path d="M17.5 19H9a6 6 0 1 1 1.3-11.86A7 7 0 0 1 23 12a4 4 0 0 1-5.5 7Z" />,
      shield: <><path d="M12 22s8-4 8-10V5l-8-3-8 3v7c0 6 8 10 8 10Z" /><path d="m9 12 2 2 4-5" /></>,
      rocket: <><path d="M4.5 16.5c-1.5 1.5-2 4-2 4s2.5-.5 4-2l2-2-2-2-2 2Z" /><path d="m14 5 5 5" /><path d="M13 4c3-2 7-2 8-1-1 1 0 5-1 7l-7 7-5-5 7-8Z" /><circle cx="16" cy="8" r="1" /></>,
      target: <><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9" /><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="5" /><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="1" /></>,
      users: <><path d="M16 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-4-4H6a4 4 0 0 0-4 4v2" /><circle cx="9" cy="7" r="4" /><path d="M22 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-3-3.87M16 3.13a4 4 0 0 1 0 7.75" /></>,
      arrow: <><path d="M5 12h14" /><path d="m13 6 6 6-6 6" /></>,
      star: <path d="m12 3 2.8 5.7 6.2.9-4.5 4.4 1.1 6.2-5.6-2.9-5.6 2.9 1.1-6.2L3 9.6l6.2-.9L12 3Z" />,
      phone: <path d="M22 16.92v3a2 2 0 0 1-2.18 2 19.8 19.8 0 0 1-8.63-3.07 19.5 19.5 0 0 1-6-6A19.8 19.8 0 0 1 2.12 4.2 2 2 0 0 1 4.11 2h3a2 2 0 0 1 2 1.72c.12.9.33 1.78.62 2.63a2 2 0 0 1-.45 2.11L8 9.73a16 16 0 0 0 6 6l1.27-1.27a2 2 0 0 1 2.11-.45c.85.29 1.73.5 2.63.62A2 2 0 0 1 22 16.92Z" />,
      mail: <><rect x="3" y="5" width="18" height="14" rx="2" /><path d="m3 7 9 6 9-6" /></>,
      location: <><path d="M20 10c0 5-8 12-8 12S4 15 4 10a8 8 0 1 1 16 0Z" /><circle cx="12" cy="10" r="2.5" /></>,
      menu: <path d="M4 6h16M4 12h16M4 18h16" />,
      close: <><path d="M6 6l12 12" /><path d="M18 6 6 18" /></>,
      spark: <><path d="m12 3 1.5 5.5L19 10l-5.5 1.5L12 17l-1.5-5.5L5 10l5.5-1.5L12 3Z" /><path d="m19 16 .7 2.3L22 19l-2.3.7L19 22l-.7-2.3L16 19l2.3-.7L19 16Z" /></>,
      layers: <><path d="m12 2 9 5-9 5-9-5 9-5Z" /><path d="m3 12 9 5 9-5" /><path d="m3 17 9 5 9-5" /></>
    };

    return (
      <svg width={size} height={size} viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.8" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
        {icons[type] || icons.spark}
      </svg>
    );
  };

  const services = [
    {
      icon: "code",
      title: "Web Development",
      text: "High-performance websites and web platforms engineered for speed, accessibility, scalability and measurable business growth.",
      tags: ["React", "Next.js", "Node.js"],
      image: "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1461749280684-dccba630e2f6?auto=format&fit=crop&w=900&q=85"
    },
    {
      icon: "design",
      title: "UI/UX Design",
      text: "Human-centered digital experiences combining research, visual systems, interaction design and conversion-focused interfaces.",
      tags: ["Figma", "Design Systems", "Prototyping"],
      image: "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1558655146-9f40138edfeb?auto=format&fit=crop&w=900&q=85"
    },
    {
      icon: "marketing",
      title: "Digital Marketing",
      text: "Data-led marketing strategies that increase visibility, attract qualified audiences and turn attention into sustainable growth.",
      tags: ["SEO", "Social Media", "Analytics"],
      image: "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1557838923-2985c318be48?auto=format&fit=crop&w=900&q=85"
    },
    {
      icon: "mobile",
      title: "Mobile Development",
      text: "Modern Android and iOS applications with intuitive interfaces, secure architecture and reliable performance.",
      tags: ["Android", "iOS", "Cross Platform"],
      image: "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1512941937669-90a1b58e7e9c?auto=format&fit=crop&w=900&q=85"
    },
    {
      icon: "cloud",
      title: "Cloud Development",
      text: "Secure cloud-native solutions designed for resilience, automation, cost efficiency and effortless scaling.",
      tags: ["AWS", "Azure", "DevOps"],
      image: "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1451187580459-43490279c0fa?auto=format&fit=crop&w=900&q=85"
    }
  ];

  const technologies = [
    ["React", "Frontend"], ["Next.js", "Frontend"], ["Node.js", "Backend"],
    ["Python", "Backend"], ["Java", "Backend"], ["Flutter", "Mobile"],
    ["MongoDB", "Database"], ["PostgreSQL", "Database"], ["AWS", "Cloud"],
    ["Docker", "DevOps"], ["Figma", "Design"], ["GitHub", "Development"]
  ];

  const process = [
    ["01", "Discover", "We understand your goals, audience, challenges and opportunities before writing a single line of code.", "target"],
    ["02", "Strategize", "We convert business requirements into a clear digital roadmap with measurable priorities.", "layers"],
    ["03", "Design", "We create intuitive interfaces and experiences that feel natural, premium and purposeful.", "design"],
    ["04", "Build", "Our engineers transform the approved experience into secure, scalable and high-quality products.", "code"],
    ["05", "Launch", "We test, optimize, deploy and monitor your solution for a confident launch.", "rocket"],
    ["06", "Grow", "We continue improving your product using data, feedback, experiments and technology.", "spark"]
  ];

  const projects = [
    ["FinEdge", "FinTech Platform", "A modern financial management experience designed around clarity, trust and frictionless digital journeys.", "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1556761175-b413da4baf72?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1200&q=85"],
    ["Medivista", "Healthcare Experience", "A patient-focused digital ecosystem that makes appointments, information and communication easier.", "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1559757148-5c350d0d3c56?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1200&q=85"],
    ["UrbanCart", "E-Commerce", "A conversion-focused shopping experience built for speed, discovery and effortless checkout.", "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1556742049-0cfed4f6a45d?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1200&q=85"]
  ];

  const testimonials = [
    ["Ananya Rao", "Founder, Nova Ventures", "The Vighnex team understood our vision quickly and turned it into a digital experience that feels far more premium than we imagined.", "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1494790108377-be9c29b29330?auto=format&fit=crop&w=300&q=80"],
    ["Rahul Mehta", "Director, Crest Solutions", "What impressed us most was the combination of design thinking and technical discipline. Communication was clear from start to finish.", "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1500648767791-00dcc994a43e?auto=format&fit=crop&w=300&q=80"],
    ["Priya Sharma", "Entrepreneur", "They did not simply build a website. They helped us think through our entire digital presence and created something our customers love.", "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1531123897727-8f129e1688ce?auto=format&fit=crop&w=300&q=80"]
  ];

  const faqs = [
    ["What services does Vighnex Technologies provide?", "We provide web development, UI/UX design, digital marketing, mobile application development and cloud development. We can also combine multiple services into one complete digital transformation engagement."],
    ["Can you build a website from an idea only?", "Yes. We can start from a concept, business requirement, rough sketch or existing website. We help define the structure, user journey, visual direction, technology and launch plan."],
    ["Do you develop mobile applications for both Android and iOS?", "Yes. Depending on project requirements, we can build native or cross-platform applications with a strong focus on performance, security and user experience."],
    ["Do you provide maintenance after launch?", "Yes. We can provide ongoing technical support, security updates, performance improvements, content changes, analytics and feature development."],
    ["How do you handle project communication?", "We maintain a structured communication process with requirement discussions, progress updates, reviews, testing and final deployment so clients always understand the current project status."],
    ["How can I start a project with Vighnex?", "Simply contact us with your idea, requirements or business challenge. We will understand your objectives and discuss the most practical next steps."]
  ];

  return (
    <div style={styles.site}>
      <nav style={styles.navbar}>
        <div style={{ ...styles.container, ...styles.navInner }}>
          <div style={styles.logo} onClick={() => scrollTo("home")}>
            <div style={styles.logoMark}>V</div>
            <div>
              <strong style={styles.logoStrong}>Vighnex</strong>
              <span style={styles.logoSmall}>TECHNOLOGIES</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div style={menuOpen && mobile ? styles.navMobile : styles.nav}>
            {["home", "about", "services", "why", "technology", "process", "projects", "testimonials", "faq", "contact"].map(item => (
              <button key={item} style={styles.navButton} onClick={() => scrollTo(item)}>
                {item === "why" ? "Why Us" : item.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + item.slice(1)}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>

          {!mobile && (
            <button style={{ ...styles.btn, ...styles.primary }} onClick={() => scrollTo("contact")}>
              Let's Connect <Icon type="arrow" size={17} />
            </button>
          )}

          <button style={styles.menu} onClick={() => setMenuOpen(!menuOpen)}>
            <Icon type={menuOpen ? "close" : "menu"} size={28} />
          </button>
        </div>
      </nav>

      <section id="home" style={styles.hero}>
        <div style={{ ...styles.container, ...styles.heroGrid }}>
          <div>
            <div style={styles.eyebrow}>Traditional Values · Digital Future</div>
            <h1 style={styles.heroH1}>Build Digital<br /><span style={{ color: C.gold }}>Possibilities.</span></h1>
            <p style={styles.heroP}>We transform ambitious ideas into meaningful digital experiences through technology, thoughtful design and strategies built for long-term growth.</p>

            <div style={styles.actions}>
              <button style={{ ...styles.btn, ...styles.primary }} onClick={() => scrollTo("contact")}>
                Start Your Journey <Icon type="arrow" size={17} />
              </button>
              <button style={{ ...styles.btn, border: "1px solid #d7c9ae", color: C.navy, background: "transparent" }} onClick={() => scrollTo("services")}>
                Explore Services
              </button>
            </div>

            <div style={styles.heroNote}>
              <Icon type="shield" size={19} />
              <span><strong style={{ color: C.navy }}>Design-led.</strong> Engineering-driven. Growth-focused.</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div style={styles.visual}>
            <img src={heroImage} alt="Vighnex Technologies" style={styles.heroImg} />
            <div style={{ ...styles.badge, left: mobile ? -5 : 0, top: mobile ? 55 : 100 }}>
              <div style={styles.badgeIcon}><Icon type="spark" size={21} /></div>
              <div><strong style={styles.badgeStrong}>Smart Solutions</strong><span style={styles.badgeSpan}>Built around your goals</span></div>
            </div>
            <div style={{ ...styles.badge, right: mobile ? -5 : 0, bottom: mobile ? 30 : 75 }}>
              <div style={styles.badgeIcon}><Icon type="rocket" size={21} /></div>
              <div><strong style={styles.badgeStrong}>Digital Growth</strong><span style={styles.badgeSpan}>From idea to impact</span></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section id="about" style={styles.section}>
        <div style={{ ...styles.container, ...styles.grid2 }}>
          <div style={{ position: "relative" }}>
            <img src="https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1521737711867-e3b97375f902?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1000&q=85" alt="Professional team collaborating" loading="lazy" style={styles.aboutImg} />
            <div style={styles.aboutCard}><strong style={styles.aboutNumber}>360°</strong><span style={styles.aboutText}>Digital thinking from strategy to scale</span></div>
          </div>

          <div>
            <div style={{ ...styles.eyebrow, justifyContent: "flex-start" }}>About Vighnex</div>
            <h2 style={styles.aboutH2}>Rooted in values. Driven by innovation.</h2>
            <p style={styles.aboutP}>Vighnex Technologies is a digital solutions company focused on creating technology that feels useful, intuitive and genuinely valuable.</p>
            <p style={styles.aboutP}>Our approach brings strategy, design, engineering and growth together so businesses do not have to manage disconnected digital partners.</p>

            <div style={styles.values}>
              {[
                ["Human First", "We design around real people and real problems."],
                ["Quality Always", "Every detail matters from concept to deployment."],
                ["Think Long Term", "We build foundations that can evolve with you."],
                ["Move With Purpose", "Clear priorities create meaningful progress."]
              ].map(v => (
                <div style={styles.value} key={v[0]}>
                  <strong style={styles.valueStrong}>{v[0]}</strong>
                  <span style={styles.valueSpan}>{v[1]}</span>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>

            <button style={{ ...styles.btn, ...styles.primary }} onClick={() => scrollTo("contact")}>Work With Us <Icon type="arrow" size={17} /></button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section id="services" style={{ ...styles.section, ...styles.dark }}>
        <div style={styles.container}>
          <div style={styles.title}>
            <div style={styles.eyebrow}>What We Do</div>
            <h2 style={{ ...styles.h2, color: C.white }}>Complete digital solutions under one roof.</h2>
            <p style={{ ...styles.p, color: "#cbd8e0" }}>From your first sketch to your next million users, our capabilities are designed to work together.</p>
          </div>

          <div style={styles.services}>
            {services.map(service => (
              <div key={service.title} style={styles.service}>
                <img src={service.image} alt={service.title} loading="lazy" style={styles.serviceImg} />
                <div style={styles.serviceIcon}><Icon type={service.icon} size={25} /></div>
                <h3 style={styles.serviceH3}>{service.title}</h3>
                <p style={styles.serviceP}>{service.text}</p>
                <div style={styles.tags}>
                  {service.tags.map(tag => <span key={tag} style={styles.tag}>{tag}</span>)}
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section id="why" style={{ ...styles.section, ...styles.dark }}>
        <div style={{ ...styles.container, ...styles.why }}>
          <div>
            <div style={{ ...styles.eyebrow, justifyContent: "flex-start" }}>Why Choose Us</div>
            <h2 style={styles.whyH2}>Technology with a human touch.</h2>
            <p style={styles.whyP}>Good technology should simplify complexity, not add to it. We combine strategic thinking, modern engineering and thoughtful communication to make digital projects easier to build and better to experience.</p>

            <div style={styles.whyList}>
              {[
                ["Business Understanding", "We start with your objectives instead of jumping directly into technology.", "target"],
                ["Transparent Collaboration", "Clear milestones, regular reviews and straightforward communication.", "users"],
                ["Modern Engineering", "Scalable architecture, clean development practices and performance-focused delivery.", "code"],
                ["Security & Reliability", "Security-conscious implementation and dependable digital foundations.", "shield"],
                ["Growth Mindset", "We design products that can improve continuously after launch.", "spark"]
              ].map(x => (
                <div style={styles.whyItem} key={x[0]}>
                  <div style={styles.check}><Icon type={x[2]} size={18} /></div>
                  <div><strong style={{ display: "block", marginBottom: 4 }}>{x[0]}</strong><span style={styles.whySpan}>{x[1]}</span></div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          <img src="https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1552664730-d307ca884978?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1100&q=85" alt="Business team meeting" loading="lazy" style={styles.whyPhoto} />
        </div>
      </section>

      <section id="technology" style={styles.section}>
        <div style={styles.container}>
          <div style={styles.title}>
            <div style={styles.eyebrow}>Technology Stack</div>
            <h2 style={styles.h2}>Built with technology that moves forward.</h2>
            <p style={styles.p}>We choose tools based on the problem, not trends. Our stack supports fast development today and sustainable growth tomorrow.</p>
          </div>

          <div style={styles.tech}>
            {technologies.map(item => (
              <div style={styles.techItem} key={item[0]}>
                <span style={styles.dot}></span>
                <strong>{item[0]}</strong>
                <small style={styles.techSmall}>{item[1]}</small>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section id="process" style={{ ...styles.section, background: C.light }}>
        <div style={styles.container}>
          <div style={styles.title}>
            <div style={styles.eyebrow}>Our Process</div>
            <h2 style={styles.h2}>From first conversation to lasting impact.</h2>
            <p style={styles.p}>A structured process keeps creativity focused, development predictable and every decision connected to your goals.</p>
          </div>

          <div style={styles.process}>
            {process.map(item => (
              <div style={styles.processItem} key={item[1]}>
                <div style={styles.processNum}>{item[0]}</div>
                <div style={styles.processIcon}><Icon type={item[3]} size={29} /></div>
                <h3 style={styles.processH3}>{item[1]}</h3>
                <p style={styles.processP}>{item[2]}</p>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section style={styles.stats}>
        <div style={{ ...styles.container, ...styles.statsGrid }}>
          {[
            ["50+", "Digital Ideas Transformed"],
            ["100+", "Projects & Deliverables"],
            ["24/7", "Digital Possibilities"],
            ["100%", "Commitment to Quality"]
          ].map(s => (
            <div style={styles.stat} key={s[1]}>
              <strong style={styles.statStrong}>{s[0]}</strong>
              <span style={styles.statSpan}>{s[1]}</span>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </section>

      <section id="projects" style={styles.section}>
        <div style={styles.container}>
          <div style={styles.title}>
            <div style={styles.eyebrow}>Selected Work</div>
            <h2 style={styles.h2}>Ideas become experiences.</h2>
            <p style={styles.p}>A glimpse into the kind of digital experiences we love creating.</p>
          </div>

          <div style={styles.projects}>
            {projects.map(project => (
              <div style={styles.project} key={project[0]}>
                <img src={project[3]} alt={project[0]} loading="lazy" style={styles.projectImg} />
                <div style={styles.projectBody}>
                  <div style={styles.category}>{project[1]}</div>
                  <h3 style={styles.projectH3}>{project[0]}</h3>
                  <p style={styles.projectP}>{project[2]}</p>
                  <button style={styles.projectLink} onClick={() => scrollTo("contact")}>Discuss a Similar Project <Icon type="arrow" size={15} /></button>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section id="testimonials" style={{ ...styles.section, background: C.light }}>
        <div style={styles.container}>
          <div style={styles.title}>
            <div style={styles.eyebrow}>Client Voices</div>
            <h2 style={styles.h2}>Built on trust. Remembered for results.</h2>
            <p style={styles.p}>Strong partnerships are at the center of everything we build.</p>
          </div>

          <div style={styles.testimonials}>
            {testimonials.map(item => (
              <div style={styles.testimonial} key={item[0]}>
                <div style={styles.stars}>{[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map(i => <Icon key={i} type="star" size={15} />)}</div>
                <p style={styles.testimonialP}>“{item[2]}”</p>
                <div style={styles.person}>
                  <img src={item[3]} alt={item[0]} loading="lazy" style={styles.personImg} />
                  <div><strong>{item[0]}</strong><span style={{ ...styles.personRole, display: "block" }}>{item[1]}</span></div>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section id="faq" style={styles.section}>
        <div style={styles.container}>
          <div style={styles.title}>
            <div style={styles.eyebrow}>FAQ</div>
            <h2 style={styles.h2}>Questions before we begin?</h2>
            <p style={styles.p}>Here are answers to some of the things clients ask us most often.</p>
          </div>

          <div style={styles.faqWrap}>
            {faqs.map((faq, index) => (
              <div style={styles.faq} key={faq[0]}>
                <button style={styles.faqQ} onClick={() => setActiveFaq(activeFaq === index ? -1 : index)}>
                  <span>{faq[0]}</span>
                  <span style={{ fontSize: 24, color: C.gold }}>{activeFaq === index ? "−" : "+"}</span>
                </button>
                {activeFaq === index && <div style={styles.faqAnswer}>{faq[1]}</div>}
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section id="contact" style={{ ...styles.section, ...styles.contact }}>
        <div style={{ ...styles.container, ...styles.contactGrid }}>
          <div>
            <div style={{ ...styles.eyebrow, justifyContent: "flex-start" }}>Let's Connect</div>
            <h2 style={styles.contactH2}>Have an idea? Let's make it real.</h2>
            <p style={styles.contactP}>Tell us what you are building, what you want to improve or simply where you want to go next. We would love to hear the story behind your idea.</p>

            <div style={styles.details}>
              <div style={styles.detail}><div style={styles.detailIcon}><Icon type="phone" size={19} /></div><div><strong style={styles.detailStrong}>Call Us</strong><span style={styles.detailSpan}>+91 98765 43210</span></div></div>
              <div style={styles.detail}><div style={styles.detailIcon}><Icon type="mail" size={19} /></div><div><strong style={styles.detailStrong}>Email Us</strong><span style={styles.detailSpan}>info@vighnex.com</span></div></div>
              <div style={styles.detail}><div style={styles.detailIcon}><Icon type="location" size={19} /></div><div><strong style={styles.detailStrong}>Location</strong><span style={styles.detailSpan}>Hyderabad, India</span></div></div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <form style={styles.form} onSubmit={e => { e.preventDefault(); alert("Thank you! Your enquiry has been received."); }}>
            <div style={styles.formTitle}>Start a conversation</div>

            <div style={styles.formGrid}>
              <div style={styles.field}><label style={styles.label}>YOUR NAME</label><input style={styles.input} type="text" placeholder="Enter your name" required /></div>
              <div style={styles.field}><label style={styles.label}>EMAIL ADDRESS</label><input style={styles.input} type="email" placeholder="you@example.com" required /></div>
              <div style={styles.field}><label style={styles.label}>PHONE NUMBER</label><input style={styles.input} type="tel" placeholder="+91 XXXXX XXXXX" /></div>
              <div style={styles.field}><label style={styles.label}>SERVICE</label><select style={styles.select} defaultValue=""><option value="" disabled>Select a service</option><option>Web Development</option><option>UI/UX Design</option><option>Digital Marketing</option><option>Mobile Development</option><option>Cloud Development</option><option>Complete Digital Solution</option></select></div>
              <div style={{ ...styles.field, gridColumn: mobile ? "auto" : "1/-1" }}><label style={styles.label}>PROJECT DETAILS</label><textarea style={styles.textarea} placeholder="Tell us a little about your idea, goals or requirements..." /></div>
            </div>

            <button style={{ ...styles.btn, ...styles.goldBtn, width: "100%" }} type="submit">Send Enquiry <Icon type="arrow" size={17} /></button>
          </form>
        </div>
      </section>

      <footer style={styles.footer}>
        <div style={styles.container}>
          <div style={styles.footerGrid}>
            <div>
              <div style={styles.logo}>
                <div style={styles.logoMark}>V</div>
                <div>
                  <strong style={{ ...styles.logoStrong, color: C.white }}>Vighnex</strong>
                  <span style={{ ...styles.logoSmall, color: "#b7c7d0" }}>TECHNOLOGIES</span>
                </div>
              </div>
              <p style={styles.footerDescription}>Building meaningful digital experiences where traditional values meet modern technology. Create. Build. Deploy. Grow.</p>
            </div>

            <div>
              <h4 style={styles.footerH4}>Company</h4>
              <div style={styles.footerLinks}>
                <button style={styles.footerButton} onClick={() => scrollTo("about")}>About Us</button>
                <button style={styles.footerButton} onClick={() => scrollTo("why")}>Why Choose Us</button>
                <button style={styles.footerButton} onClick={() => scrollTo("projects")}>Our Work</button>
                <button style={styles.footerButton} onClick={() => scrollTo("contact")}>Contact</button>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div>
              <h4 style={styles.footerH4}>Services</h4>
              <div style={styles.footerLinks}>
                <button style={styles.footerButton} onClick={() => scrollTo("services")}>Web Development</button>
                <button style={styles.footerButton} onClick={() => scrollTo("services")}>UI/UX Design</button>
                <button style={styles.footerButton} onClick={() => scrollTo("services")}>Digital Marketing</button>
                <button style={styles.footerButton} onClick={() => scrollTo("services")}>Mobile Development</button>
                <button style={styles.footerButton} onClick={() => scrollTo("services")}>Cloud Development</button>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div>
              <h4 style={styles.footerH4}>Let's Connect</h4>
              <div style={styles.footerLinks}>
                <button style={styles.footerButton} onClick={() => scrollTo("contact")}>Start a Project</button>
                <button style={styles.footerButton} onClick={() => scrollTo("faq")}>FAQs</button>
                <button style={styles.footerButton} onClick={() => scrollTo("technology")}>Technology</button>
                <button style={styles.footerButton} onClick={() => scrollTo("process")}>Our Process</button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div style={styles.bottom}>
            <span>© 2026 Vighnex Technologies. All Rights Reserved.</span>
            <div style={styles.socials}>
              <a style={styles.social} href="https://www.linkedin.com" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">in</a>
              <a style={styles.social} href="https://www.instagram.com" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">◎</a>
              <a style={styles.social} href="https://www.facebook.com" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">f</a>
              <a style={styles.social} href="https://www.youtube.com" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">▶</a>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </footer>
    </div>
  );
}
